exposure: systemic sclerosis (SSc) disease stage (stable vs active/early)
cohort: Pregnant women with systemic sclerosis (SSc) followed at an Israeli medical centre between 2003-2020, whose pregnancies were analyzed based on SSc disease stage.
finding: Active maternal SSc disease during pregnancy increases the risk of SSc aggravation and adverse neonatal outcomes, while planned pregnancies during stable SSc disease show favorable maternal and neonatal outcomes, although IUGR/LBW remains common.
